tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Sequences and net charges of human beta-defensin-3 (hBD-3), human beta-defensin-4 (hBD-4), and H4.
footnotes: Canonical cysteine residues are highlighted in gray. The intermediate region (I region) is underlined and the R residues of I region are bolded.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: LD90 for hBD-3, hBD-4, and H4 against pathogenic bacteria.
footnotes: Values are the mean ± SD of three biological replicates.
Significantly different (p < 0.05) from the activity of hBD-3.
Significantly different (p < 0.05) from the activity of hBD-4.

tables.label: Table 3
tables.caption: LD90 for H4 and antibiotics against pathogenic bacteria.
footnotes: Values are the mean ± SD of three biological replicates.
Significantly different (p < 0.001) from the activity of H4.
